knowledge:
- key_parameters: min_size=Minimum size constraint for filtering sets ;; max_size=Maximum size constraint for filtering sets ;; background=A vector of elements (e.g., quantified genes) to restrict sets to before filtering ;; type=The similarity coefficient type in similarity(), which can be "jaccard", "overlap", or "otsuka" ;; cutoff=The similarity threshold used in clusterSets() to group sets ;; method=The agglomeration method used in clusterSets() hierarchical clustering ;; h=The height at which to cut the dendrogram in clusterSets() ;; overlap=The minimum number of elements in common required to decompose a pair of sets in decomposeSets() ;; statistic=A matrix of gene-level statistics (e.g., z-scores) passed to cameraPR() ;; index=A list of gene sets passed to cameraPR() ;; scale_by=Scaling method for bubble sizes in enrichmap(), e.g., "max" or "row" ;; plot_sig_only=Logical indicating whether to only plot significant sets/genes in enrichmap()
- alternatives: limma::cameraPR=TMSig's cameraPR (matrix method) is significantly faster and allows simultaneous inference of multiple contrasts or coefficients compared to the original limma implementation.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you need to perform competitive gene set enrichment analysis (CAMERA-PR) on pre-ranked statistics across multiple contrasts, reduce redundancy in molecular signatures by clustering or decomposing overlapping sets, and visualize the results using customizable bubble heatmaps.
- pitfalls: Failing to restrict gene sets to the experimental background before filtering can lead to incorrect set sizes and misleading overlap proportions. Redundancy in gene sets (e.g., nested Gene Ontology terms) can drive multiple false-positive significant results; clustering or decomposing sets should be performed to address this.

workflows.name: gene_set_enrichment_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Read, filter, cluster, and analyze gene sets for competitive enrichment using pre-ranked statistics, followed by bubble heatmap visualization.
input: y (matrix of gene expression data or pre-calculated gene-level statistics)
workflows.stages: 1. Read gene sets from a GMT file ;; 2. Filter gene sets by size and background genes ;; 3. Compute set similarity and cluster redundant sets ;; 4. Decompose or invert sets (optional) ;; 5. Perform competitive gene set testing using CAMERA-PR ;; 6. Visualize differential expression and gene set enrichment results using bubble heatmaps
workflows.code:
pathToGMT <- system.file(
    "extdata", "c5.go.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt.gz",
    package = "TMSig"
)

geneSets <- readGMT(path = pathToGMT)

filt <- filterSets(x = geneSets, 
                   min_size = 10L, 
                   max_size = 500L)

topGenes <- table(unlist(geneSets))
topGenes <- head(sort(topGenes, decreasing = TRUE), 2000L)
background <- names(topGenes)

geneSetsFilt <- filterSets(
    x = geneSets, 
    background = background, 
    min_size = 10L
)

setSizes <- lengths(geneSetsFilt)
setSizesOld <- lengths(geneSets)[names(geneSetsFilt)]
overlapProp <- setSizes / setSizesOld

geneSetsFilt <- geneSetsFilt[overlapProp >= 0.7]

imat <- sparseIncidence(x = geneSetsFilt)

jaccard <- similarity(x = geneSetsFilt)
overlap <- similarity(x = geneSetsFilt, type = "overlap")
otsuka <- similarity(x = geneSetsFilt, type = "otsuka")

clusterDF <- clusterSets(x = geneSetsFilt, 
                         type = "jaccard", 
                         cutoff = 0.85, 
                         method = "complete",
                         h = 0.9)

clusterDF$overlap_prop <- overlapProp[clusterDF$set]
clusterDF$n_char <- nchar(clusterDF$set)

o <- with(clusterDF, 
          order(cluster, set_size, overlap_prop, n_char, set,
                decreasing = c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE),
                method = "radix"))
clusterDF <- clusterDF[o, ]

keepSets <- with(clusterDF, set[!duplicated(cluster)])
geneSetsFilt <- geneSetsFilt[keepSets]

geneSetsFilt2 <- filterSets(geneSetsFilt, max_size = 50L)
decompSets <- decomposeSets(x = geneSetsFilt2, overlap = 10L)

invertedSets <- invertSets(x = geneSetsFilt)

res <- cameraPR(statistic = modz, 
                index = geneSetsFilt)

enrichmap(x = resDA, 
          scale_by = "max",
          n_top = 15L,
          plot_sig_only = TRUE,
          set_column = "gene", 
          statistic_column = "z", 
          contrast_column = "contrast", 
          padj_column = "adj.P.Val", 
          padj_legend_title = "BH Adjusted\nP-Value", 
          padj_cutoff = 0.05,
          cell_size = grid::unit(20, "pt"),
          heatmap_args = list(
              name = "Z-Score",
              column_names_rot = 60,
              column_names_side = "top"
          ))

enrichmap(x = res, 
          scale_by = "row",
          n_top = 20L,
          set_column = "GeneSet", 
          statistic_column = "ZScore", 
          contrast_column = "Contrast",
          padj_column = "FDR",
          padj_legend_title = "BH Adjusted\nP-Value",
          padj_cutoff = 0.05,
          cell_size = grid::unit(13, "pt"),
          heatmap_args = list(
              name = "Z-Score", 
              column_names_rot = 60,
              column_names_side = "top"
          ))
